description.title: תנאי פוליסת ביטוח לרכב
description.summary: This table outlines the terms of service for 'extended road services package for electric vehicles'. It details conditions, exclusions, and compensation amounts related to the service.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת את תנאי השירות של 'חבילת שירותי דרך מורחבת לרכבים חשמליים', כולל תנאים, חריגות וסכומי פיצוי. השירותים ניתנים עבור הרכב המבוטח בלבד, ואינם כוללים תשלום עבור טעינה, תחזוקה או אגרת תיקון, אלא אם כן טעינה היא בהתאם לתנאי המסמך. השירותים יסופקו בתוך גבולות מדינת ישראל והאזורים יהודה ושומרון, למעט שטחי השלטון העצמי. במקרה שהספק לא יכול לספק את השירותים, ישולם למבוטח סכום של 300 ש״ח או הסכום הסביר הנדרש לביצוע השירות, בניכוי השתתפות עצמית. חבילת שירותי דרך מורחבת לרכבים חשמליים, טעינת רכב חשמלי, 300 ש״ח, השתתפות עצמית, יהודה ושומרון.

sketch:
2. General
2.1 During the insurance period, the service provider will provide the insured with the 'extended road services package for electric vehicles ' services in accordance with and subject to whatsoever appearing in this service document.
2.2 In order to avoid any doubt, the service in accordance with this service document shall not include any other or additional payment - ancillary or emanating therefrom -including payment for charging expenses, except charging in accordance with the conditions of this service document, vehicle maintenance payments and payment of the repair levy for the vehicle which is entitled to service.
2.3 The services will be provided only for the vehicle which is entitled to service and the service recipient will not be entitled to transfer the right to receive services to another vehicle, except if the insured vehicle is replaced, a vehicle substitute endorsement is added to the policy and the service provider grants its advance consent to the replacement of the insured vehicle.
2.4 The vehicle break-in service, wheel replacement and electric vehicle charging services will be provided 24 hours a day.
2.5 The services will be provided within the territorial boundaries of the State of Israel and the areas of Judea and Samaria, excluding the Autonomy areas, access
to which is not prohibited and restricted at that time by any authorized authority.
2.6 In the event that the service provider is prevented from supplying the services for any reason which is under its control, the service provider will pay the insured directly the sum of NIS 300 (there-hundred shekels) or the reasonable sum required to execute the service, paid by the insured against an invoice -the lower of the two -less the deductible fee, as customary.
This payment shall replace the service provider as agreed and fixed compensation to the service recipient and the service recipient shall not have any allegation against the service provider in connection therewith.
